presentation.label: PLAY starts from the beginning
presentation.summary: PERSONALIZE setting: when ON, [PLAY] always starts the sequencer from the beginning and never pauses.
presentation.overview: A global sequencer setting: [PLAY] always starts from the beginning and never pauses. Turn it on or off in PERSONALIZE. Default OFF is stock play/pause, so installing the module changes nothing until you enable it.
highlights: Default OFF: stock [PLAY] pause and continue.
ON: [PLAY] starts from the beginning even if the sequencer is already running or paused. [STOP] still stops.
PERSONALIZE only: not a Part or project field. Mute Modes cannot be chosen with it until PERSONALIZE is a shared base table.
usage: Press [PROJ], open SYSTEM, then PERSONALIZE, and scroll to PLAY START.
Turn LEVEL (or YES) to ON. Close the menu.
Press [STOP], then [PLAY]: the sequencer starts. Press [PLAY] again while it runs: it starts from the beginning instead of pausing. [STOP] still stops.

controls.name: PLAY START
controls.doc: OFF is stock play/pause. ON makes panel [PLAY] always start from the beginning. LEFT/RIGHT clamp; YES wraps. Stored in PERSONALIZE, not in the project.

limitations: OS 1.40C. Hardware and emulator transport checks have not been run.
Conflicts with Mute Modes: both relocate the PERSONALIZE tables and poke the ANDY restore length.
MIDI START / CONTINUE / STOP do not follow this setting.

storage.label: ROM unit, detour and PERSONALIZE table growth
storage.conditions: One ColdFire unit, one six-byte detour, ANDY length pokes and relocated PERSONALIZE pointer arrays. No DSP memory.

processing.label: ColdFire, per [PLAY] press
processing.conditions: Runs in the [PLAY] key handler when PLAY START is ON and the transport is not stopped. Nothing per sample.

impact.conditions: Key-press handler; default OFF adds a test and a branch.

cpu.rationale: A handful of ColdFire instructions on a [PLAY] press; no per-frame work.

memory.rationale: Small ROM unit and one PERSONALIZE word with its battery shadow.

tests.summary: No emulator or hardware transport results yet. Stock guards for the [PLAY] state load, PERSONALIZE count and ANDY restore sites match original OS 1.40C hashes recorded in TESTING.md. Publication checks cannot pass until captures, performance and a unit report exist.
